subject: Evidence request: new hire vetting and security training for SOC 2
messages:
From: TrustBridge Audit <audit@trustbridge.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: new hire vetting and security training for SOC 2

Hi Rishi / Lauren,

As part of the upcoming SOC 2 fieldwork for ClearPath Financial (Week of Aug 9), we need a short package showing your new-hire vetting and security training controls covering hires from 2026-07-01 through 2027-06-30. Specifically we are requesting: 

- A roster of hires with role and hire date (redacted PII OK).
- Evidence that background checks were completed or that the exception/waiver process was used.
- Training completion records for mandatory security topics for those hires (or learning platform exports).
- A short note on redaction approach and chain-of-custody where sensitive PII is removed.

If you can provide these as attachments or a Drive folder link by EOD Jul 30 that would keep us on schedule. If redactions are needed, a short memo describing the redaction process is sufficient initially.

Thanks,
Olivia Marsh
Senior Auditor | TrustBridge Audit

Olivia — thanks for the clear ask. We can deliver a preliminary bundle by tomorrow EOD. Plan: 

1) Send a hires roster CSV with role/hire-date and HR ID only (no SSNs). File: onboarding_roster_2026-2027.csv (attached).
2) Attach a redaction guidance PDF that documents how HR redacts PII before sharing: background_redactions_instructions.pdf.
3) Export training completions from LMS for the date range and attach as training_completion_export_Q2_2027.xlsx (will include completion timestamps and course IDs).

Lauren / Mina — can you confirm the roster export is final and that HR is comfortable with the redaction memo? If there's anything else TrustBridge needs (specific control narratives or screenshots of the LMS completion page) we can include that in a follow-up.

Thanks — quick follow-up from HR / security side: 

- Roster: exported and validated. Column set we are providing: HR_ID, First_Name (redacted to initial), Last_Name (redacted to initial), Role, Hire_Date, Location, Background_Check_Status, Background_Check_Date. We will not include PII (DOB, SSN, address).
- Background checks: we ran standard vendor checks for all hires in the cohort. Where exceptions exist (contractors converted to FTE), there is an exceptions log; we will include a redacted exceptions summary.
- Training: LMS export includes course IDs and completion timestamps; certificates are stored separately. If you need a sample certificate image, we can provide one redacted.
- Chain-of-custody: HR will sign a short cover memo confirming that redactions were performed by HR and a copy of the unredacted source is retained in our secure HR system; we'll attach that memo as "Redaction_Custody_Memo.txt".

I am attaching the redaction guidance PDF and will upload the roster + training export to the Drive folder Rishi linked to. Aditya — can you confirm you have the DocuSign packet for the auditor NDA/TOU (ClearPath required) so we can send access?

Lauren Bishop
Director, People Operations
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

From: Olivia Marsh <olivia.marsh@trustbridge.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: new hire vetting and security training for SOC 2

Lauren / Rishi,

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the level of detail — that's exactly what we need for fieldwork. A couple of clarifying items after a quick pass: 

- For the Background_Check_Status column, can you use standard values ("Cleared" / "Exception" / "Pending")? That will make sampling easier.
- The redaction custody memo: simple signed statement is fine, please include the name and title of the person who performed the redaction and the storage location for the unredacted source.
- Please also provide one redacted sample of the original background check (PDF stub is fine) so we can confirm redaction coverage.

Once we have the Drive link and the DocuSign access (if needed), we'll confirm the sample selection for testing. If it's easier, we can accept the first delivery as embargoed to auditors only and we will not redistribute.

Thanks again — see you on the Aug 9 kickoff.

Olivia Marsh
Senior Auditor | TrustBridge Audit
